question: Following the Battle of Colachel (1741), a captured Dutch naval officer joined the service of King Marthanda Varma and modernized the Travancore army. Who was this officer?
explanation: Eustachius De Lannoy was a Dutch naval officer who was taken prisoner by Travancore after the Battle of Colachel. He subsequently entered the service of Maharaja Marthanda Varma, earned his trust, and was appointed as the Valia Kappithan (Senior Admiral/General). De Lannoy modernized the Travancore army by introducing European-style firearms, training, and fortification techniques (such as the Nedumkotta or Travancore Lines).
